source_evidence.name: Road-150 Red, 62
source_evidence.description_en: This bike is ridden by race winners. Developed with the Adventure Works Cycles professional race team, it has a extremely light heat-treated aluminum frame, and steering that allows precision control.
source_evidence.description_zh: 此自行车曾为赛车手夺冠立下汗马功劳。与 Adventure Works Cycles 专业赛车队联合设计，它的铝制车架极其轻巧且经过热处理，操纵装置可以实现精准控制。
